    MultiplicativeBasisDeformations.MeshWalk.exists_hcobdry_twice

    Lemma 10.2 for twice a cocycle of A⁽²⁾ (Proposition 10.3) #

    integral-deformations.tex. For a Hochschild cocycle μ̄ of A⁽²⁾ of positive degree q, the cocycle μ̃ = 2μ̄ of 𝒪P is a coboundary (exists_hcobdry_twice): the corrections of the lifted modules and arrows are twice those of μ̄ (IntegralTransport); their mesh errors are twice a family of degree q + 2 ≥ 3, a derivative by Lemma B.2 (two_smul_mem_imageD), so an arrow change removes them; the projective corner of the lifted modules is 𝒪P (corner_surj, corner_inj), and CornerDeriv.eq_hcobdry concludes.

    This is the composite j = 0 and injectivity of Ψ₄ used in the proof of Proposition 10.3, restricted to the classes i_*[μ̄], which is all that proof uses.
